findings.claim: the tier-wide config exemption re-opened the one-step moved-base smuggle: config set to the NEW base skipped the guard, judging the move zero times from the old range (replayed live)
the detached-HEAD fallback anchored on the base commit's copy, which always predates the move — every CI clone would brick forever after a base advance landed
the authoring clone sat in the exempted state: a pin command installed the config and nothing enforced the unset — a sticky off-switch
the changed predicate had zero automated coverage; the register was empty because the dispatch step was skipped

register correction: f1 was resolved with evidence 'fee5130' — a commit hash typed where a path belongs; the intended evidence is tools/task-coverage.mjs at commit fee5130. Verdict on this DONE task will fail on the phantom path; the correction is recorded here because resolutions are append-only
findings.justification: the phantom evidence path in f1 cannot be edited out of an append-only register; the done gate passed before the typo and verdict-on-done is advisory. The error itself is the tamper trail.
